name: tpu7x-ironwood-16chip-kimi-k3-proxy
description: A transparent COCOSSim proxy plus an official-spec roofline target. This is not a cycle-accurate TPU7x hardware model.

roofline_precision.compute_peak: mixed: FP8 for routed experts and latent-MoE projections, BF16 otherwise

assumptions: The 32 COCOSSim cores stand in for the 32 TensorCores in a 16-chip TPU7x slice and apply ideal output-dimension sharding; the simulator does not model the dual-chiplet hierarchy.
The vector width is an explicit proxy assumption because Google does not publish an equivalent COCOSSim vector-lane count.

The 1 GHz value normalizes raw COCOSSim cycles and is not asserted to be the physical TPU7x clock; absolute analytical time uses only published aggregate chip peaks and a dimensionless efficiency normalized against the same 32-core proxy.
Compute-only COCOSSim cycles are paired with a separate roofline calculation because the repository's DRAMSim3 configuration models legacy HBM2, not TPU7x HBM.
The global 8-bit simulator datatype affects storage and buffer chunking, not compute precision; mixed MXFP4/MXFP8 and unquantized tensors are accounted for only in the analytical report.
Generated traces already flatten batch times query tokens into matrix M, so the simulator runtime batch size must remain 1.
Tensor, expert, and context parallel communication are excluded from the COCOSSim cycle result and must be reported as unsupported overheads.
